structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun token "p(doom)" was created at about 08:46 UTC and moved to PumpSwap within about 3 minutes (08:49). It links to an @allTheYud (Eliezer Yudkowsky) tweet, and its description says "Fees to @alltheyud via UsePaid", so creator fees go to his handle. It is a fee-sharing celebrity meme, and he has not been shown to endorse it. It pumped about 340%, reaching an all-time high of about $312k, and is now around $181k, down about 29% in the last 5 minutes. Within minutes, at least 8 copycat "P(DOOM)" tokens with the same name launched, and several of them each carry $20-30k liquidity and $60-145k hourly volume. That splits the attention.

narrative.description: P(doom) is a well-known AI-safety meme: the probability that AI causes catastrophe. Yudkowsky is its best-known figure. The token appears to reference a specific @allTheYud tweet and sends fees to his handle via UsePaid.
narrative.why_spreading: A famous person plus a known meme, and a fee-sharing launch that implies a possible claim or acknowledgement. The copycat swarm shows traders are chasing a fresh tweet. I could not read the tweet (X returned 402) and found no evidence that Yudkowsky acknowledges the token. He has historically been cool on crypto, so an endorsement is unlikely.

token_connection.why_this_token: It links the source tweet, routes fees to @allTheYud, and was the first of the current swarm to migrate (08:49 UTC). It also has the highest liquidity and volume among the live clones.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 8 same-name tokens: 3VooWk... ($201k mcap, $145k hourly volume), Exk6... ($130k), 6aHoh... ($87k), 4gxe... ($75k) and others. An earlier DrqtB... token from about 05:21 UTC shows a $308k mcap but zero liquidity. A PDOOM token (C3K6...) is weeks old.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 287 bundler wallets, a 76% bot/degen rate, 416 fresh wallets and 24 snipers. On the other side: 25 smart wallets, 3 renowned wallets, and 1,375 unique buyers in 15 minutes. There are no paid boosts, and the LP is fully burned. The dev (funded from Binance) has launched 5 tokens, the best of which peaked at $312k (possibly this one), and holds 0% now.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts or the tweet content, or whether Yudkowsky has reacted.

It needs an unlikely Yudkowsky acknowledgement to double again. The LP burn limits pool-pull rug risk, but a slow bleed is likely.
